title: ADR-0161 K8 item 17: a dated note fixes the record-scope shape — scope: [{ object, ids }] on search and the adapter filter, a parent object reached through a lookup the source lists in metadataFields
body:
repo:cloud#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbW5anP6GDaVi5LKi2U

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed (topic child). Source: topic #37000; maintainer ruling on #37308 Q3 = B (comment 7168192820, decision thread 2026-11-25). Split out of #37308 because an implementation card's file surface does not carry `docs/adr/**`.
Grading: area:ai · Task · p2 (topic) · reach: the knowledge search contract every adapter implements · evidence: read.

## 维护者速读
- 做什么：在 ADR-0161 上加一条带日期的补充说明，把「限定范围检索」的接口形状定下来：可以限定在某几条记录里搜，也可以通过知识源列出的查找字段限定在上级记录（比如「只在这一份制度的条款里搜」），这是您刚裁的 B。
- 为什么先做：这个形状是适配器契约的新成员，ADR 规定新成员要先写进记录，#37308 的代码才能动工。
- 需要你做的：合并这个 PR（ADR 属受治理面）。

## What
1. A dated note under ADR-0161 K8 item 17 (today "Deferred"), in the PR #37263 precedent's form: the member's name and type on the service's `search` options and on `AdapterSearchOptions` (`scope: [{ object, ids }]`), what an adapter must do with it (apply before ranking), and the ruling's parent arm: an entry may name a parent object when the source lists a lookup to it in `metadataFields`; an entry whose object no searchable source indexes or reaches answers no hits (the same answer for a withheld source).
2. State that K8 rules 3 and 5 are amended by this one member only; no other member is added.
3. Name #37308 as the implementing card and #37311 (row 12) as the tool-argument card.

## Acceptance
- The note quotes the ruling comment id and the maintainer's words; it changes no earlier text of the record.
- Docs-only PR (`docs/adr/**`), Tier H: the maintainer merges.

Parent: #37000. Reader: the `domain:skills` lane via this project's card thread (`repo:cloud#1`). Blocks #37308.
Dedupe: `"K8 item 17"` 1 (#37308); `ADR-0161 scope note` 0 open.
